story: A strong 16-rider breakaway formed after a long battle, but UAE kept the gap under control. Debruyne was the last survivor and led onto the gravel section of Puerto El Bartolo, before Pogačar caught and passed him. Mas surprisingly bridged back to Pogačar just before the summit. Pogačar briefly went off the road on the descent but recovered without crashing. Pogačar comfortably beat Mas in a sprint-à-deux. Debruyne capped off his impressive day by finishing third.
